$comment: The one place for the add-ins' address and identity. Every URL in both manifests and the task pane's API address (<origin>/api) come from baseUrl; tools/build.mjs --base overrides it for a local run. The ids are the add-ins' permanent identities in Office and Partner Center: never change them.

outlook.name: Attachment Converter for Converter Studio
outlook.description: Fit the attachments of a message under 16 or 10 MB for sending (photos made smaller on your computer) and convert attachments with Converter Studio: HEIC to JPG, Office files to PDF, smaller PDFs and more.

office.name: File Converter for Converter Studio
office.description: Insert pictures Office cannot open (HEIC, camera RAW, AVIF, WebP, EPS, Illustrator, a PDF page), insert the text of a scan, and export the document to formats Office does not save, with Converter Studio.
